title: PRAISE FROM
THE SUNRISE
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: soft golden sunrise over forest horizon
dew drops on morning grass close up
mist rising over calm mountain lake
warm sun rays hitting pine needles
golden hour light over rolling hills

scenes.a: The heavy weight of yesterday still lingers in your mind as you face today alone.
From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’s name is to be praised.
Lord, help me to fix my eyes on your eternal greatness instead of my immediate fears.
May my life be a continuous reflection of your goodness in everything I do this day.
Guide my thoughts and my actions so that your love shines through all my interactions.
I surrender my agenda into your hands trusting that you are already working ahead today.
